specification.objective: Round the leading employee icon in the wide Team directory so it matches the 8 px radius already used by equivalent icon tiles after PR #137, without changing selection or high-contrast behavior.

requirements.statement: In the non-compact Team directory, the leading employee badge icon container uses an 8 px BorderRadius in both light and dark themes.
The container keeps its existing size, fill colors, border colors and selected/high-contrast states; only the corner radius changes.
Compact Team layouts continue to omit the leading employee icon.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A widget test at 1440 px in light and dark themes locates the container that wraps Icons.badge_rounded and proves its BoxDecoration borderRadius equals BorderRadius.circular(8).
The same test proves the container remains 40 x 40 with a border, and the existing Team page tests, including selection, high-contrast and compact-layout cases, keep passing.

invariants.statement: The change is presentation-only; API calls, permissions, employee data and navigation are unchanged.
Selected and high-contrast colors of the icon container remain those defined by AppTheme.adminColors and the color scheme.

forbidden_states.statement: The wide Team directory renders the leading employee icon with square corners.
The compact Team layout starts rendering the leading employee icon.

inputs.statement: The Team directory at the locked baseline, where the leading icon BoxDecoration has no borderRadius.

outputs.statement: A one-line radius correction in the employee list tile and a focused regression test, with retained POLIS Red and validation evidence.

failure_semantics.statement: The Red probe fails on the locked baseline because the leading icon container borderRadius is null instead of BorderRadius.circular(8); the target passes the same test.
Compilation or setup errors are not accepted as behavioral Red evidence.
